name: notion-list-session-events
description:
List short summaries of saved events in a Custom Agent session.

If availability is not already known for this connection, call get_tool_access with {} before using this tool. Reuse the returned access map across tools; check the status and restricted_parameters.

after_sequence.description: Load the next page of events starting after this sequence number.

before_sequence.description: Load the previous page of events ending before this sequence number.

count.description: Maximum number of committed events to return.

session_url.description: Use the complete session_url returned by session tools, unchanged. Format: session://<spaceId>/<sessionId>. Shorthand session://<sessionId> and thread://<sessionId> use the connected workspace. Fully qualified URLs must refer to that workspace.
